developer_description: A thrilling dungeon crawler with endless replayability and a deep story.

reviews.text: Addictive roguelike loop. One more run turned into 5 hours. Controls are tight and responsive.
Pixel art is gorgeous but the balance is broken. Some weapons are useless and RNG decides every run.
Boss fights are hard but fair. Music slaps.
Game-breaking bug: save file corrupted after update 1.2. Devs not responding on forums.
Perfect for short sessions on Steam Deck. Plays great on handheld.
Only 3 biomes, content runs out after 15 hours. Not worth 20 euros yet.
Co-op mode is chaotic fun, even if it lags a bit with 4 players.
Unfair difficulty spikes, felt cheap not challenging.
